title: Software pipelining
key_contribution: Reference overview of software pipelining as a compiler technique for overlapping loop iterations to hide instruction latency.

title: Basic Instruction Scheduling (and Software Pipelining)
key_contribution: Practical guide to software pipelining on RISC processors, including register allocation strategies for pipelined loops.

title: Vectorized VByte Decoding
key_contribution: Applied software pipelining to SIMD VByte decoding loop, demonstrating 2-4x speedup through overlapping decode iterations.
